question: What thresholds, categories and dual-approval rules govern an expense or disbursement?
decision: Use only tenant-ratified spending/approval thresholds by account and class; demo-only examples follow DEC-IA-18 until adoption. Creator/requestor, approver and reconciler independence is enforced per transaction and mandate; no account holder may approve their own expense. Exceptions require governed documented authority and audit.
originalProposedDecision: Per org, same default thresholds as DEC-IA-18; the person submitting an expense can never approve it.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
